name: Gunther
source:
Role: Hero
Likes: Virtue (his rapier)
Dislikes: Goddess Edyssa
Alliance: Bastion

With his effeminate looks and gallant demeanor, Gunther is Bastion's most recognizable figure. It's said that Bastion's orphanages soothe their children to sleep by reciting his heroic deeds. Be wary of his angelic visage: with his cherished sword Virtue, Gunther revels in tormenting his foes and forcing them to recant.

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
